meta.description: RC3 Outreach Automation Pack. n8n orchestrates only; Laravel decides. Enable N8N_ENABLED on the CRM + point N8N_WEBHOOK_URL at the n8n webhook BASE url (the CRM appends each topic's path from config('n8n.routes')). Link the 'CRM Service Token' credential (php artisan n8n:token) and set CRM_API_URL + N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET. CRM_API_URL is the app root; workflows append /api/v1/crm/...
